[#](53341a)Mandrake is never a polite harvest. A mature root sometimes comes quietly, and sometimes wakes as a shrieking creature instead — especially at night.[#]()

[#](53341a)When the crop awakens, the living root keeps nearby players sickened until it is killed.[#]()
pages.title: Mandrake

pages.text: [#](53341a)Leather and white wool. Worn on the head, they block the nausea scream — and blunt a Banshee's cry — so large harvests are far less miserable.[#]()
